This position serves a critical role at the South Florida Natural Resouces Center (SFNRC) within Everglades National Park, serving in the following roles: Directs the financial planning development efforts for the SFNRC and oversees and tracks SFNRC expenditures by serving as liaison between SFNRC staff and the Director.

Plans, develops, coordinates, and implements Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and processes for all aspects of the SFNRC administrative activities. This duty requires interpretation of various federal administrative policies to make sure that the developed SOPs to facilitate the work of the SFNRC are compatible with agency and unit policies.

Directs all SFNRC procurement activities needed to acquire supplies, equipment, materials, and service contracts while assuring work is done through proper sources, with appropriate documentation and justifications.

Directs the preparation and tracking of all contracts and assistance agreements needed by the SFNRC and works closely with the Major Acquisition Buying Office during all phases.

Directs the human resources function for the SFNRC, providing specific guidance on personnel matters for the SFNRC management team and staff while implementing initiatives to foster a positive work environment and promote collaboration among staff.

Directly supervises management analysts and administrative support assistants while directly working with a budget analyst.
Requirements Continued... You may be required to travel overnight away from home occasionally. You must obtain a government charge card for travel purposes. You may be required to complete training and obtain/maintain a government charge card with travel and/or purchase authority.

All qualifications must be met by the closing date of this announcement-08/05/2026-unless otherwise stated in this vacancy announcement. Credit will be given for all appropriate qualifying experience.

For current Federal employees, if hours worked per week are not included on your resume, you must submit a non-award SF-50 for each federal position listed as part of your application to be used to validate your work schedule and determine the amount of qualifying experience that you will be granted.

An award SF-50 will not be acceptable documentation for which to consider your amount of qualifying experience. For all other applicants who are not current federal employees, your resume must state either "full-time" (or "40 hours a week") or "part-time" with the number of hours worked per week to ensure proper crediting of specialized experience.

Failure to adequately provide information needed to determine number of hours worked in each position may result in that time not being credited when evaluating qualifying experience.

For periods of time that reflect military service, the DD-214 or Statement of Service is sufficient to meet the full and/or part-time hours requirement as the service dates will be reflected.

EXPERIENCE: At least one full year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-11 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the public or private sectors).

This experience includes activities such as: Budget and financial management of a large organization; Development of standard operating and administrative procedures for a large organization; Advisory and human resources liaison roles to management; Acquisition and procurement (contracting and purchasing) and assistance agreements; or facilities management.

Your resume must include hours worked per week or you will not be given credit for any specialized experieince and will be found not qualified.

Volunteer Experience: Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Sentec is a Swiss-American medical device company specializing in respiratory care. Since its founding in 1999 the company utilizes a deep-tech approach that is founded on advanced science and avant-garde technologies for respiratory patients across care areas.

Sentec provides healthcare professionals worldwide with non-invasive, continuous monitoring and effective therapeutic solutions. Sentec earned Kununu’s Top Company award in 2025 and 2026.

At Quaker Houghton , we are experts in the development, production and application of industrial process fluids, lubricants and coatings for the manufacturing industry. We have been an integral part in the growth of the world’s largest industrial and manufacturing companies from aerospace and automotive to primary metal and energy.

Today, we have a global presence, with our corporate headquarters located in Conshohocken, PA. Quaker Houghton is a global publicly traded company with a unique collaborative culture that supports career growth for its colleagues and offers competitive compensation and benefit programs. Our people are our greatest strength.

We are a global team of colleagues who collaborate to move forward together and exceed our customers’ expectations. As a Customer Service Representative, you will play an essential role at the heart of our operations, helping to deliver an outstanding experience for our customers.

The position can be based in Uithoorn (NL), Barcelona (Spain) or Moncalieri (Italy). Tasks What will you do? Deliver an exceptional customer service experience by consistently providing high-quality support and exceeding customer expectations.

You don’t need to come from a chemicals or manufacturing background — we’re open to candidates from other sectors such as logistics, FMCG, or similar industries. Communicating with customers and colleagues across different countries. Processing and managing customer orders. Providing updates on order status, shipments, and deliveries.

Working closely with Supply Chain, Logistics, Production, and Sales teams. Supporting quotation requests and customer enquiries. Maintaining accurate customer records and documentation. Requirements What are we looking for?

We're looking for enthusiastic and customer-focused individuals who enjoy working with people, solving problems, and learning new skills. Experience Previous customer service, supply chain, or logistics experience is helpful but not essential.

We welcome early-career professionals, recent graduates, and anyone eager to learn and grow in a professional environment. Skills & Knowledge Comfortable using Microsoft Office applications such as Outlook, Word, and Excel. Experience with ERP systems is an advantage but not required – we will provide training.

Strong communication skills in English and German (written and spoken) are essential. What will help you succeed? A genuine passion for delivering excellent customer service. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. A positive, proactive attitude and willingness to learn. Good organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to collaborate effectively with others while also managing tasks independently. Adaptability and a solution-focused mindset. A commitment to safety, quality, and doing the right thing. Benefits What do we offer? Immediate start date A fixed-term contract for 6 months , with potential to extend.

Flexible working arrangements, including remote working, with a preference for candidates located within reasonable proximity to one of our offices. An international, collaborative and dynamic work environment QH University that offers continuous training tools for all seniority levels.

Wellbeing, Colleague Resource Groups & other attractive DEI programs. Global Giving initiatives offering paid volunteering leave to dedicate to the cause of your choice. Joining a team where supporting each other is part of the culture, in a company where customer success is our own. Who are we?

Quaker Houghton is the global leader in industrial process fluids, continually improving and innovating so the world’s steel, aluminum, automotive, aircraft, machinery and industrial parts manufacturers can stay ahead in a changing world.

Our chemists, engineers and industry experts partner with our customers to continually improve their operations so they can run even more efficiently, even more effectively, whatever comes next. Our values: Live Safe, Exceed Customer Expectations, Drive Results, Embrace Diversity, Do Great Things Together and Act with integrity.

Our core values embody who we are as a company, guide our decisions and inspire us. Our commitment to these values, in words and actions, builds a safer, stronger Quaker Houghton . They are the fundamental beliefs that guide our internal conduct and our relationship with the outside world. Send us your application and FIND YOUR FUTURE!

EEO: Quaker Houghton is committed to equal employment opportunities and a workplace free of discrimination. Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, gender identity, age, disability, ethnic origin, religion, or sexual orientation.

In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, the salary range for this role is disclosed before the interview to support transparency and consistency in our hiring process. Candidates will not be asked about their salary history.

Our company uses a structured job level and salary band framework to support objective and consistent compensation decisions. Originally posted on Himalayas

Hi, wir sind SafeNow!
Ein Startup, das es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht hat, jedem Menschen auf der Welt Sicherheit zu bieten – und zwar kostenlos. Dazu entwickeln wir eine App, die dir sofortigen Zugang zu lokal relevanten Helfer:innen verschafft, egal ob es sich dabei um deine Freunde, Familie oder professionelle Helfer:innen handelt.
Wir sind ein kleines Team mit einem großen Herzen, mit Sitz in München, bestehend ca. 50 Personen mit 9 verschiedenen Nationalitäten. Wir suchen ein leidenschaftliches neues Teammitglied, das es liebt, neue Herausforderungen in einer schnelllebigen Startup-Umgebung anzugehen. Wir sind ein bunt gemischter Haufen ehrlicher und aufgeschlossener Menschen, die eine gemeinsame Vision haben, die Welt für uns und die Menschen und Orte, die wir lieben, sicherer zu machen.
Für diese Vision suchen wir eine erfahrene Person als Senior Community & Customer Support Manager (m/w/d) , die unsere Stimme auf Social Media prägt und unsere Nutzer:innen rund um App und Button vertrauensvoll begleitet
Aufgaben
Strategie & Insights: Du erarbeitest und entwickelst die gesamte Strategie für Community Management und Customer Support bei SafeNow, analysierst dafür Kennzahlen (Follower, Views, Likes u. v. m.) sowie Insights zu spezifischen Events oder Kundengruppen und leitest daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ab
Automatisierung: Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Prozesse im Community- und Support-Bereich und automatisierst sie KI-gestützt – skalierbar und übertragbar auf weitere Sprachen
AI-Einsatz: Du nutzt KI-Tools sinnvoll, um Antworten und Analysen effizienter zu gestalten
Wissensdatenbank: Du bist verantwortlich für unsere interne Wissensdatenbank und hältst sie laufend aktuell
Messages & Kommentare: Du beantwortest Nachrichten und moderierst Kommentare auf unseren Social-Media-Kanälen – TikTok, Instagram, Facebook und YouTube
Customer Support: Du bearbeitest individuelle Support-Anfragen unserer B2B- und B2C-Kundschaft rund um App und Button über Chat und E-Mail (kein Telefon-Support) sowie App-Store-Bewertungen, und teilst die daraus gewonnenen Insights mit unserem Produktteam
Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Community Management und/oder Customer Support
Erfahrung darin, eine Community- und/oder Support-Strategie eigenständig zu entwickeln und weiterzudenken
Exzellente Rechtschreibung und einen authentischen Schreibstil in Deutsch und Englisch
Erfahrung mit oder großes Interesse an Automatisierung und KI-Tools im Community- und Support-Kontext
Eine eigenverantwortliche, strategische Arbeitsweise und Lust, die Community-Strategie von SafeNow aktiv mitzugestalten
Gelassenheit und Humor – du behältst die Fassung, auch wenn die Community sie mal verliert

Purpose-Work: Starte jeden Morgen mit dem Wissen, dass Dein Beitrag die Welt sicherer macht.
Erfolgsgeschichte mitschreiben: Erhalte Anteile an unserem rasant wachsenden Startup (VSOP) und profitiere direkt vom Firmenerfolg. Du arbeitest nicht nur bei SafeNow – Du BIST SafeNow!
Freundschaftliche Kultur: Erlebe eine Leistungskultur, die auf Freundschaft und Zusammenarbeit basiert – bei uns zählt das Miteinander. Wir schaffen einen Raum, in dem Authentizität und Individualität gefeiert werden. Wir glauben fest daran, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Hintergründe zu innovativen Ideen und Lösungen führen.
Persönliche Entwicklung: Erlebe eine steile Lernkurve, viel Selbstständigkeit und Verantwortung – Dein Gestaltungsspielraum ist so groß wie Deine Ideen.
Transparenz: Erlebe bei uns ein Miteinander, das auf völliger Transparenz basiert. Du erhältst Einblicke in alle Bereiche von SafeNow und profitierst von den Inputs aller Teams. Gemeinsam feiern wir unsere Erfolge und lernen aus unseren Erfahrungen.
Einmalige Workations: Erlebe inspirierende Team-Workations – ob in einer gemütlichen Berghütte in Österreich, einer sonnigen Finca auf Mallorca oder einem idyllischen Haus am Chiemsee.Moderne Ausstattung: Genieße unseren modernen Campus mit Foodtrucks, Außenpool, Dachterrasse mit Alpenblick, eGYM Wellpass Mitgliedschaft und einem gemütlichen Büro.
Wenn Du Lust hast, Teil dieser aufregenden Reise zu sein und die Zukunft der Sicherheit mitzugestalten, dann freuen wir uns riesig darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Zeig uns, wer Du bist, was Dich antreibt und warum Du Lust hast, gemeinsam mit uns, die Welt ein kleines Stückchen besser zu machen. Schau dir in der Zwischenzeit gerne unsere Website an, um das Team und SafeNow kennenzulernen.

The Assistant Chief is instrumental in assisting the Chief, CEVE to develop, manage, and coordinate all aspects of the facility's patient experience, patient centered care, cultural transformation, and customer satisfaction outcomes and measures.

The Assistant Chief is responsible for developing tools and methods, manage existing tools and methods, collecting and analyzing results, interpreting results, and communicating results of all patient experience and customer feedback to clinical and administrative services within the Ralph H.

Johnson VA Medical Center, sites of care directly under its control, and as needed, other sites of care which may include Vet Centers, VISN VA sites, National VA sites, and Community Care.

The incumbent is also responsible for working with clinical and administrative staff to develop and implement process improvements, produce and monitor action plans used to improve patient experience scores, and report patient experience scores, action plans, and outcomes for presentation to facility leadership.

The Assistant Chief will serve as the facility expert in patient experience and customer satisfaction tools including, but not limited to Press Ganey, Veteran Signals, SHEP, secret shopper programs, PATS data management, comment cards, phone and kiosk surveys, and all other reporting measures related to patient experience and customer satisfaction.

The incumbent is directly and through subordinate staff responsible for contributing to survey design and development, sampling distributions, clinic and provider updates, managing sampling recommendations, reviewing and modifying survey distributions based on clinic and provider workload, and all other aspects necessary to ensure that all patient experience data is valid, accurate, up-to-date, and actionable.

The Assistant Chief will oversee all contract development, oversight, and actions related to patient experience and customer feedback contracts within the facility.

The incumbent will work with contractors, clinicians, and administrators to develop standard and customized survey and data collection tools and solutions essential in evaluating, trending, prioritizing and improving areas within the facility that impact patient experience and customer satisfaction.

The Assistant Chief provides administrative direction, day-to day supervision, and general objectives to achieve success through the facility Veteran's Experience Program.

The supervisor and employee develop a mutually acceptable project plan that typically includes identification of the work, the scope of the project, and deadlines for its completion.

Within the parameters of the approved project plan, the employee is responsible for planning and organizing the study, estimating resources and other costs, coordinating with staff and stakeholders, and conducting all phases of the project.

The employee informs the supervisor of potentially controversial findings, issues, or problems with widespread impact. The Assistant Chief provides general supervision of the work to be done, and defines for the incumbent the objective, priorities, and deadlines within the scope of the incumbent's responsibilities.

The incumbent has considerable autonomy in planning his/her work and in accomplishing the mission objectives of the Veteran's Experience, Patient Centered Care, and Cultural Transformation programs. The incumbent determines methods to use and approaches to take in resolving conflicts that arise.

In general, the incumbent must act professionally and execute all duties with appropriate independence. Telework eligibility will be discussed during the interview process.

To qualify for this position, applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement 07/30/2026. Time-In-Grade Requirement: Applicants who are current Federal employees and have held a GS grade any time in the past 52 weeks must also meet time-in-grade requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

For a GS-12 position, you must have served 52 weeks at the GS-11. The grade may have been in any occupation, but must have been held in the Federal service. An SF-50 that shows your time-in-grade eligibility must be submitted with your application materials.

If the most recent SF-50 has an effective date within the past year, it may not clearly demonstrate you possess one-year time-in-grade, as required by the announcement. In this instance, you must provide an additional SF-50 that clearly demonstrates one-year time-in-grade.

Note: Time-In-Grade requirements also apply to former Federal employees applying for reinstatement as well as current employees applying for Veterans Employment Opportunities Act of 1998 (VEOA) appointment.

Specialized Experience: You must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade GS-11 in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Examples of specialized experience would typically include, but are not limited to: Plan, coordinate, and evaluate patient experience or customer experience improvement initiatives; Analyze customer feedback, survey results, and performance metrics to identify trends and recommend process improvements; Collaborate with multidisciplinary clinical and administrative staff to implement performance improvement activities; and Develop reports, presentations, or recommendations for leadership using performance and customer experience data.

You will be rated on the following Competencies for this position: Accountability Customer Service Decisiveness Flexibility Interpersonal Skills Problem Solving Resilience Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religions; spiritual; community; student; social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Note: A full year of work is considered to be 35-40 hours of work per week.

Part-time experience will be credited on the basis of time actually spent in appropriate activities. Applicants wishing to receive credit for such experience must indicate clearly the nature of their duties and responsibilities in each position and the number of hours a week spent in such employment.

Physical Requirements: The work environment involves the normal everyday risks and discomforts of an office setting. Work is typically performed in an adequately lighted, temperature-controlled, and ventilated office and off-site at various locations.

Coordination and participation in meetings and other activities outside the main facility will require presence in a variety of in-house and off-station areas and facilities throughout the service area. Frequent contact with other individuals, including Veteran patients, presents the possibility of exposure to communicable diseases.

For more information on these qualification standards, please visit the United States Office of Personnel Management's website at https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/.

The Digital Modernization Sector has an opening for a Tier 1 Customer Service Representative .

The hourly rate for this position is $17.86/hr.
Position requires shift flexibility to support 8am – 8pm on Monday through Friday (a 8x5 day operation) with expanded weekend operations in September and October.
The Tier 1 Customer Service Representative (CSR ) will be experienced representative responsible for answering Tier 1 customer inquiries. CSR will:
Provide Tier 1 service desk support for insurance issuers, Agents and Web brokers, CMS/CCIIO application users, Health Insurance Exchanges and state agencies based on Inquiries are received via phone, 1-855-CMS-1515 (1-855-267-1515), or email, CMS_FEPS@cms.hhs.gov .
Provide account access support, such as password resets and unlocking accounts for various marketplace applications including COTS products such as TIBCO MFT Log user inquiries in Service Now and assign to the right groups internally before assigning to Tier 2 support.
Triage inquiries by marketplace functions and assign to the right marketplace systems/CCIIO business groups as applicable - skills and knowledge provided by training via our training instructors.
Provide general policy information supplied by the business owners and Tier 2 systems Provide process guidance to the requesters seeking help/guidance based on information provided by CMS/CCIIO business owners and Tier 2 support teams.
Respond effectively and accurately to or properly route IT inquiries and escalations for The Centers for Medicaid and Medicare Services Marketplace Service Desk.
Provide the customer with accurate and complete responses; provide ticket status information, while meeting and exceeding service expectations.
Utilize a Knowledge Base to locate scripted answers and to thoroughly document information into the database.
Escalate requests to appropriate IT departments throughout the CMS Marketplace Service Desk organization to prevent work stoppage due to technology challenges.

Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.
Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.
Deine Aufgaben
Du bearbeitest Kundenanliegen telefonisch und per E-Mail und übernimmst die professionelle Kommunikation bei komplexen Anliegen rund um die PV-Anlage.
Du nimmst Kundenbeschwerden und Reklamationen auf, analysierst die jeweiligen Sachverhalte und erarbeitest gemeinsam mit den zuständigen Fachabteilungen passende Lösungen.
Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen den beteiligten Fachbereichen, um die Fertigstellung, Nachbesserung oder Richtigstellung von Photovoltaikanlagen sicherzustellen.
Du betreust Kunden mit einer empathischen, lösungsorientierten Kommunikation, informierst transparent über den Bearbeitungsstand und stellst die Kundenzufriedenheit in den Mittelpunkt.
Du verfolgst offene Vorgänge eigenständig nach, dokumentierst sämtliche Maßnahmen sorgfältig und begleitest den gesamten Prozess bis zur erfolgreichen Klärung des Anliegens.
Dein Profil
Du verfügst über eine hohe Belastbarkeit und behältst auch in anspruchsvollen sowie konfliktbehafteten Kundensituationen einen kühlen Kopf und eine professionelle Arbeitsweise.
Du zeichnest Dich durch eine offene, freundliche und kommunikative Persönlichkeit aus und schaffst es, sowohl mit Kunden als auch mit internen Ansprechpartnern vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufzubauen.
Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes Durchsetzungsvermögen und kannst Kundenanliegen gegenüber Fachabteilungen konsequent vertreten, ohne dabei die Zusammenarbeit aus den Augen zu verlieren.
Du arbeitest lösungsorientiert, denkst proaktiv und findest auch bei komplexen Herausforderungen praktikable und kundenorientierte Lösungen.
Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Kunden, überzeugst durch Deine Serviceorientierung und setzt alles daran, eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen
Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️
Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen
Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.
Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.
Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.
Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.
Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.
Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.
Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.
Dein Extra-Boost - 29 + 2 Urlaubstage, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.
Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

About Nivoda
Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.
Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

Our Customer Support team is the heartbeat of Nivoda's mission. We're highly attentive, customer-obsessed agents distributed across 8+ countries, dedicated to delivering exceptional service and seamless experiences 24/7 via live chat, phone, WhatsApp, and email. This is a team that thrives on responsiveness, continuous improvement, and deep cross-functional collaboration to solve personalised, nuanced needs of retailers across several regions.

As a Senior Customer Support Executive at Nivoda, you'll play a vital role in ensuring our customers have a seamless journey with Nivoda.

Your main responsibilities include answering customer inquiries via live chat, WhatsApp, and email, handling day-to-day client issues related to logistics, orders, website bugs, and serving as the voice of the customer internally.

In addition to delivering exceptional customer support, you'll help onboard and train new joiners, provide guidance and coaching to colleagues, handle complex customer escalations, and assist with the day-to-day operations. Collaboration with all departments is key, making you the glue that binds our organisation together.
If you are a problem solver, with a customer-centric approach to your work, this is an opportunity to make a real impact in a rapidly evolving industry.

BETTER CAKEZ wurde 2024 von Isabelle Forster gegründet – aus ihrer großen Liebe zu Kuchen und einer ganz persönlichen Herausforderung heraus.
Aufgrund einer Gluten- und Laktoseunverträglichkeit war Isabelle stark in ihrer Ernährung eingeschränkt und konnte vor allem eines nicht mehr essen: ihren heißgeliebten Bäckerkuchen. Also stellte sie sich zwei Jahre lang selbst in die Küche und entwickelte Kuchen, die vor allem eines sein sollten: sündhaft lecker – aber gleichzeitig gesünder und leicht verträglich.
Das Ergebnis begeisterte nicht nur sie selbst, sondern auch ihr gesamtes Umfeld. So sehr, dass Isabelle überzeugt wurde, ihr zweites Staatsexamen in Jura nicht mehr anzutreten und stattdessen ihre gesünderen Snack-Kuchen to go auch anderen zugänglich zu machen.
Heute gibt es unsere drei Snack-Kuchen to go, die mit bis zu 30 % Gemüse vollgepackt sind. Sie sind glutenfrei, vegan, ohne raffinierten Zucker, ohne künstliche Konservierungsstoffe und ohne Palmöl – und das alles in Bio-Qualität und mit langer Haltbarkeit ganz ohne Kühlung.
Und das Wichtigste hätten wir fast vergessen: Sie sind sündhaft lecker.

The Opportunity – Customer Support Specialist III (Remote - US)
We are looking for an enthusiastic Customer Support Specialist III to join our Support organization. In this role, you’ll ensure our crew members and client users have their product questions answered and technical issues resolved quickly, accurately, and with care.
Customer Support Specialist III's at Wrapbook work across a range of case types—from high-volume, repeatable issues to complex, high-context production scenarios.

Depending on business needs and your strengths, you may be aligned to a team focused on Worker users and scaled support (Express Desk) or a team focused on non-Worker users and high-touch, relationship-driven support (Partnership Team).

In all cases, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring payees are compensated compliantly and on time, while delivering a concierge-quality support experience.

Own a portfolio of cases and inbound interactions (email, live chat, and phone via Salesforce), serving as the primary point of contact from first touch through resolution for crew members and client users.
Diagnose and troubleshoot product behaviors and production workflows: investigate issues, reproduce bugs, identify root cause, and advise on next steps or workarounds.
Manage your case backlog with clear ownership and urgency: prioritize work by customer impact, SLA, and escalation risk; proactively follow up internally and externally until issues are fully resolved.
Partner closely with Customer Success, Payroll Ops, Product, and Engineering to resolve customer issues, translating customer context into actionable technical detail.
Identify trends and product gaps: log high-quality bug reports and product requests in Linear (or similar tools), including replication steps and business impact.
Escalate urgent or production-critical issues via PagerDuty or established escalation channels and help coordinate cross-functional response through resolution.
Deliver a concierge support experience: adapt communication style to the customer and situation, explain solutions clearly, and anticipate follow-up needs.
Contribute to team knowledge and operational excellence by creating and maintaining SOPs, templates, troubleshooting guides, and other internal documentation.
Support continuous improvement efforts by sharing best practices, surfacing opportunities for workflow optimization, deflection, or automation, and incorporating QA feedback into your day-to-day work.
Mentor and support junior teammates as needed through case guidance, escalation support, and modeling strong customer judgment and communication.
What you’ll have
2+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, or an administrative role supporting film and television production (or equivalent B2B SaaS experience).
Strong knowledge of Film & Television production workflows; Production Accounting or payroll experience is highly valued.
Confidence communicating with customers via phone, email, and live chat, including comfort being on the phone for extended periods when needed.
Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to document customer issues clearly and create effective internal tickets and documentation.
Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with a habit of researching, validating, and understanding solutions before communicating them.
Demonstrated ability to manage a case queue responsibly, multitask across multiple issues, and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Comfort working in an early-stage, high-growth company where priorities evolve and adaptability matters.
Experience collaborating cross-functionally and a genuine enjoyment of working with others to achieve shared outcomes.
Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Linear (or similar bug tracking tools), PagerDuty, Slack, and Notion (or the ability to learn them quickly).

Motion Picture Union Payroll experience.
Experience supporting high-volume case environments or complex, high-sensitivity customer scenarios.
Experience creating or maintaining SOPs, workflows, or training materials for support teams.
Experience identifying deflection opportunities, improving self-serve resources, or contributing to automation initiatives.
Experience contributing to QA programs, mentoring junior support staff, or supporting team enablement.
Experience creating operating procedures or content for AI-powered support tools.

At Mercury, we're entering a similar phase of evolution.

Leaders at companies like Google, Databricks, Snowflake, RingCentral, Toastmasters, and Dale Carnegie use Yoodli to ramp reps faster, improve message delivery, and reduce coaching burden on frontline managers. We're building a new category called Experiential Learning: an AI-powered category that helps people learn through conversational roleplays. ## ##
Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung gestaltest du aktiv die Zukunft unserer globalen Serviceorganisation. Du führst den Customer Service der Rychiger AG strategisch, wirtschaftlich und personell und treibst die Transformation von klassischen Serviceleistungen hin zu datengetriebenen und digitalen Servicelösungen voran.
## Dein zukünftiges Wirkungsfeld ##
* Strategische, fachliche, personelle und wirtschaftliche Führung des Bereichs Customer Service
* Führung und Weiterentwicklung der globalen Serviceorganisation mit dem Ziel, Synergien zu nutzen, Standards zu etablieren und die internationale Zusammenarbeit zu stärken
* Treibende Rolle bei der Transformation des Servicegeschäfts hin zu datengetriebenen und digitalen Dienstleistungen
* Gesamtverantwortung für die Leistungsfähigkeit und Wirtschaftlichkeit des Servicegeschäfts inklusive Qualität, Kosten, Termine und Profitabilität
* Strategische Weiterentwicklung und aktive Vermarktung des Serviceportfolios gegenüber internationalen Kunden
* Sicherstellung einer vorausschauenden Ressourcenplanung gemeinsam mit den internationalen Gesellschaften
* Umsetzung der Unternehmensstrategie und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des Verantwortungsbereichs
* Stärkung der bereichsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette
## Weshalb dir das gelingt ##
* Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium auf Stufe FH / Universität oder ähnliches, ergänzt durch eine höhere Weiterbildung in Betriebswirtschaft, Management oder Unternehmensführung (z.B. EMBA, MAS, DAS oder CAS)
* Mehrjährige Führungsverantwortung im internationalen und exportorientierten Maschinen- oder Anlagenbau mit fundierter Erfahrung im Servicegeschäft
* Ausgewiesene Erfolge in der strategischen Weiterentwicklung und Transformation von Serviceorganisationen
* Fundiertes Verständnis für digitale Servicemodelle, datengetriebene Dienstleistungen sowie den Einsatz von künstlicher Intelligenz zur Optimierung von Maschinen, Serviceprozessen und Kundenunterstützung
* Unternehmerisches Denken sowie ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Markt-, Kunden- und Geschäftsanforderungen
* Authentischer Führungsstil, verbunden mit hoher Kommunikationsstärke, Veränderungsbereitschaft und Umsetzungsfähigkeit
* Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, Mitarbeitende zu befähigen, Verantwortung zu übertragen und eine erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit über Fachbereiche und Standorte hinweg zu fördern
* Stilsichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2) sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse (C1)
## Was wir dazu beitragen ##
* Enge, hierarchiefreie Zusammenarbeit mit dem CEO/Eigentümer sowie mit der Geschäftsleitung
* Gelebte Unternehmenskultur und Werte (wertschätzender Umgang sowie Kundenfokussierung)
* Transparente Strukturen und schnelle Entscheidungswege
* Einbindung in zukunftsweisende Transformationsprozesse (z. B. KI-Integration, Internationalisierung)
* Attraktive, erfolgsorientierte Vergütung (inkl. Vorsorgelösung)
* Ein motiviertes, bereits stark aufgestelltes Führungsteam (Direct Reports)
* Attraktive und moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit Fitness- und Ruheraum

We are looking for a CustomerExperience & Ecommerce Specialist to provide high-quality customer supportfor a premium UK footwear brand while supporting key ecommerce operations. Therole will manage customer enquiries, complaints, product fit and sizing advice,returns, and reviews, while also assisting with Shopify product updates,content management, and seasonal catalogue launches.
The role also has a strong AI andcontinuous improvement component, including reviewing AI-generated customerresponses, improving help center content and macros, and identifyingopportunities to increase automation without compromising the customerexperience. In addition, the successful candidate will provide limitedadministrative support to the founder and work across systems including Gorgias,Shopify, SWAP, Mintsoft, and Canva.

We are looking for a trustworthy, smart andenthusiastic person with a very strong command of English and a personalitythat thrives on interacting with customers as well as problem solving.
A suitable candidate must be able todemonstrate a willingness to proactively solve problems and to respondpositively to customer enquiries. A good understanding of Shopify would behelpful but is not essential. Training will be provided.
A key area of accountability ofthis role is customer support, from first contact through to resolution.Adjacent ecommerce and administrative tasks are included and will be trained.This is a customer service role first, supported by ecommerce operations, andgeneral assistant.

Excellent written English, with warmth, clarity and accuracy
A proactive problem solver who takes ownership rather than waiting to be asked
Confident and comfortable interacting with customers
Previous customer service experience with a direct-to-consumer ecommerce or retail brand, ideally serving UK or US customers
Experience with a helpdesk platform such as Gorgias, Zendesk, Re:amaze or similar
Working knowledge of Shopify is helpful but not essential, as training will be provided
Exposure to Canva or similar tools not essential but nice to have.
Comfortable working with AI assisted tools as part of daily work
Able to work independently with limited supervision, and to raise issues early rather than allow them to build
An affinity for the customer base is valued. Our customers are predominantly women over 50 who expect a considered, personal and unhurried level of service.

Customerservice
Act as the customer service agent covering the UK and, where agreed, US customer service requirements
Answer tickets created in the Gorgias portal in a timely manner
Answer tickets raised through the chat function on the UK and US websites
Respond to customer enquiries and complaints, escalating where appropriate
Become familiar with Gorgias and work to improve its efficiency and effectiveness
Handle fit, sizing and product suitability enquiries, building genuine product knowledge of the range so that advice is helpful and specific rather than generic
Maintain a consistent brand tone of voice in all written contact, in line with the brand guidelines provided
Monitor and respond to customer reviews across the review platforms in use, escalating any that need the founder to see them
Returnshandling
Returns are managed through a portal run by SWAP. Most returns are processed and approved automatically, but light touch management is required for the following
Checking items missing in transit
Customers requiring changes to a return submission
Cross checking with the fulfillment center system for items returned damaged
Liaising with the SWAP partner and the fulfillment partner to resolve issues
This requires agent access to the returns portal and the fulfillment center system. Training will be provided.
Flag recurring return reasons and fit or sizing patterns in a short monthly summary, so that repeat causes can be addressed at product level
Shopify andecommerce support
Assist with new product uploads
Assist with content management
SEO optimization, working with AI assistance
Own the accuracy of product data on the site, including sizing information, descriptions, images and stock status, working to a defined upload checklist
Support seasonal catalogue drops, including preparing and uploading new season product in line with the trading calendar
AI andcontinuous improvement
A meaningfulshare of customer contact is already resolved by Gorgias AI. This part of therole is about improving that.
Review AI resolved conversations for quality and tone, and correct where the response did not meet the brand standard
Improve and extend macros, help center content and AI instructions so that routine questions are answered accurately first time
Track and report the proportion of contacts resolved without human involvement, with the aim of increasing it over time while protecting customer experience
Identify contacts that should never be handled by AI, particularly complaints and sensitive customer situations, and make sure these reach a person quickly
Executiveand administrative support
The roleincludes a small element of administrative support to the founder. This isdeliberately bounded at approximately four to six hours per week and coverstasks such as document preparation, research, data gathering, diary and travelcoordination and general administrative assistance.

It is scoped this way sothat customer service remains the clear primary accountability and the rolestays coherent to recruit for and to manage. If broader executive assistantsupport is needed over time, this is better addressed as a separateconversation once this role is established.

s.h: WHAT DOES A WORK AT HOME CONTACT CENTER REPRESENTATIVE DO?
s.t:
This position supports customer service, technical support, and customer sales interactions. This role requires you to interact with hundreds of customers each week across the country to resolve support issues, sell new products and services, and ensure best in class customer experience.

In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer interactions, you will need to be confident, fully engaged, a team player, and dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.

Listen to customers, understand their needs, and resolve customer issues

Recognize sales opportunity and apply sales skills to upgrade
Explain and position the products and processes with customers
Appropriately escalate customer dissatisfaction with managerial team
Ensure first call resolution through problems solving and effective call handling

For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with a variety of companies, providing valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. We have a large team of skilled and passionate professionals who are committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients.

We are seeking a highly reliable, proactive, and detail-oriented Helpdesk Support Agent to join our team at LevelUp for a 6-month fixed-term contract . In this role, you will serve as the first point of contact for internal teams of LevelUp's clients, providing critical first-line support for core business applications.
Your primary mission will be to ensure that internal operations and sales processes run seamlessly and without disruption. Operating in a fast-paced but methodical remote environment, you will troubleshoot user issues, manage access requests, and resolve support tickets through Slack, Zendesk, and other internal admin tools.

Because you will be supporting internal stakeholders across various business units, maintaining high responsiveness, outstanding written communication, and an active online presence throughout your shift is essential for success.
This contract is an excellent opportunity to deepen your technical expertise in enterprise-grade platforms such as Salesforce and NetSuite while working within a collaborative, structured, and fast-growing team. Please note that this is a 6-month fixed-term contract with no guarantee of conversion to a permanent position.
Reference: 2632-304138

First-Line Application Support: Provide dependable, timely support and troubleshooting for business applications, primarily focusing on user requests within Salesforce and NetSuite.
Access & Ticket Management: Process and manage user access requests, permission updates, and support inquiries arriving via Slack, Zendesk, and specialized admin tools.
Meticulous Documentation: Document, categorize, and tag all support interactions and tickets accurately to maintain high-quality system records and enable continuous process improvement.
Effective Escalations: Investigate complex technical or process-related issues, gather necessary details, and escalate them efficiently to Product Management, Order to Cash, Deal Desk, and Systems Engineering.
Proactive Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams and the immediate Help Desk team to coordinate prompt issue resolution and ensure alignment.
Continuous Learning: Stay fully updated on new system features, operational updates, and documented best practices through ongoing training and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Ad Hoc Operations Support: Assist with testing new processes or system updates, contribute to knowledge base documentation, and support user onboarding and access setups as required.

Experience: A minimum of 2–3 years of experience in live chat customer service, technical customer support, or internal helpdesk environments.
Salesforce Proficiency: Critical hands-on experience supporting users, managing records, and troubleshooting basic permissions and issues within Salesforce.
NetSuite Proficiency: Strong familiarity and hands-on experience resolving user support issues and navigating business workflows in NetSuite.
Ticketing Tools: Experience managing and prioritizing support queues in Zendesk or similar ticketing platforms, ensuring strict adherence to ticket hygiene and tagging standards.
Uncompromising Reliability: A proven track record of dependability. You must maintain an active online presence and be consistently responsive during scheduled working hours, with zero tolerance for going missing in action (MIA) or abandoning active support chats.
Communication Skills: Strong, professional, and service-oriented written English. Ability to communicate complex troubleshooting steps clearly via text-based platforms (Slack, Zendesk).
Work Schedule: Absolute commitment to working standard US Central Time hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CT), Monday to Friday.
Location/Holiday Alignment: Must be based in the Philippines and aligned with observing Philippines Holidays.
Nice-to-Have - SQL Knowledge: Basic SQL querying capabilities for troubleshooting and data-related analysis.
Nice-to-Have - Data Analysis: Experience with BigQuery or general reporting platforms.
Nice-to-Have - Task Management: Familiarity with Jira for issue tracking and development workflows.
Nice-to-Have - Operational Workflows: Experience or familiarity with sales workflows, Deal Desk, or Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.

**VITOGAZ Switzerland AG** est le principal fournisseur suisse de gaz liquéfié. En tant que filiale du groupe Rubis, international et coté en bourse, nous assurons chaque jour, avec plus de 150 collaborateurs et une flotte de véhicules propre, une fourniture fiable et sécurisée dans toute la Suisse. Parallèlement, nous développons continuellement nos activités dans le domaine du conseil pour la transition énergétique.
**Votre rôle**
En tant que **Spécialiste Support Fonctionnel IT**, vous êtes l-interlocuteur central pour nos collaborateurs concernant les questions et demandes de support liées à nos applications métier.
Vous assistez les utilisateurs dans l-utilisation de nos outils IT, analysez et coordonnez leurs demandes et les accompagnez jusqu-à leur résolution réussie. Parallèlement, vous contribuez à faire évoluer notre support IT, à promouvoir l-autonomie des utilisateurs et à améliorer continuellement nos applications et services IT.
**Vos tâches**
* **Support :** Assurer le support fonctionnel de 1er et 2e niveau pour nos applications métier (ERP, CRM et autres outils internes) ainsi que le support de 1er niveau pour l-environnement de poste de travail IT
* **Gestion des tickets :** Traitement, diagnostic, classification et suivi des incidents et demandes via l-outil ITSM ainsi qu-escalade documentée si nécessaire vers les équipes IT internes ou prestataires externes
* **Support applicatif :** Suivi des tickets auprès des fournisseurs d-applications jusqu-à la vérification fonctionnelle et la confirmation de la résolution
* **Gestion des connaissances :** Création et maintenance de la base de connaissances IT ainsi que l-identification des demandes récurrentes et le développement de solutions en libre-service adaptées
* **Formation & documentation :** Introduction et formation des nouveaux collaborateurs ainsi que la création de supports de formation, tutoriels et documentations utilisateurs
* **Projets IT :** Participation aux projets applicatifs, notamment aux tests d-acceptation utilisateur (UAT), tests fonctionnels, analyses d-erreurs, déploiements et activités de gestion du changement
* **Amélioration continue :** Développement et optimisation des processus de support IT, organisation des flux de tickets, surveillance des SLA et analyse des thèmes de support récurrents
* **Change Advisory Board :** Préparation des réunions CAB, rédaction des procès-verbaux et suivi des mesures décidées
* **Fonction d-interface :** Recueil des besoins des départements métiers et collaboration étroite avec l-équipe IT, les power users et les partenaires externes
**Votre profil**
* Formation en **informatique, informatique de gestion** ou expérience professionnelle équivalente dans le support IT ou fonctionnel
* Expérience en **support applicatif, fonctionnel ou utilisateur**
* Bonne compréhension des processus métier et des applications d-entreprise telles que **ERP et CRM**
* Expérience avec un **outil ITSM** ainsi qu-une bonne compréhension de la gestion des incidents et des bases de connaissances
* Excellentes capacités analytiques et méthode de travail structurée
* Très bonnes compétences en communication et plaisir à transmettre des connaissances
* Forte orientation service et utilisateur ainsi qu-une manière de travailler autonome et fiable
* **Très bonnes connaissances en allemand et en français**
**Atouts**
* Connaissances en **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Microsoft Dynamics CRM et Freshdesk**
* Expérience dans la création de bases de connaissances ainsi que dans la réalisation de tutoriels et documentations utilisateurs
